title_en: The LEGO Mario Kart – Mario & Standard Kart Set Has Dropped to a New Low Price at Amazon, Knocking $20 off Its List Price
summary_en: Amazon has dropped the LEGO Mario Kart – Mario & Standard Kart set down to a new low price of $149.99. Compared to its full price, you're saving $20.
body_en:
Amazon has dropped an exciting discount on one of our favorite Nintendo LEGO sets : Mario Kart – Mario & Standard Kart . Normally this build is listed for $169.99, but lucky shoppers can grab it for just $149.99 at the retailer, making for a discount of $20 overall. Not to mention, this deal marks the lowest price we've seen so far on this build, which is quite a treat since we're in between sale events .
And what a delight this build looks to be for Mario Kart fans. With 1,972 pieces in total, and recommended for adults, it sees you assembling Mario (complete with a movable head and arms) in his Standard Kart from Mario Kart for display. As mentioned before, it's among our picks of the best LEGO Nintendo sets and is even one of our top picks for adult builders .
Writer Kevin Wong built and reviewed this set when it was originally released. In his We Build , he wrote that, "Casual builders will appreciate its bright primary colors and its big, chunky parts, which make for a surefire crowd-pleaser. Experienced LEGO builders will appreciate the intricacy of the Kart's construction and the absence of stickers; every piece of visual flair is printed directly onto the bricks themselves."
If you're curious to see more of the build, you can have a look through the We Build's photos above.
This deal price may not be around for long, so be quick to secure the set on sale while it's still available. And if you're looking for even more LEGO deals to drop some cash on right now, check out our roundup of Today’s Top Deals for more that caught our eye.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the guides and commerce teams here at IGN.
